## Telegram Channel Connector

Safe default:
`metadata.dispatchEnabled = false`

In safe mode, messages are previewed only.

To send real messages:

1. Select your Telegram credential in **Send Telegram Message**.
2. Pass `metadata.dispatchEnabled = true`.
3. Confirm the queue contains the correct `chatId`.
4. Test with one message before activating.

This v1 sends button labels and callback values as text.
A later Telegram Approval Response workflow will add real inline callback buttons.

No AI credits are used.
